resources.string: Maps a USB keyboard key to a touch on screen so games like Geometry Dash can be played with a keyboard. The service intercepts hardware key events and injects taps; it does not read screen content.
Service: NOT running — enable it in Accessibility settings
1. Plug in the USB keyboard (OTG).\n2. Enable the Jonnyskeys service below.\n3. Press the mapped key to tap the screen — hold the key to hold the touch.
Press a key on the keyboard…
Tap position X: %1$d%% of screen width
Tap position Y: %1$d%% of screen height
For Geometry Dash any tap position works for jumping; the defaults (50%, 70%) avoid the pause button. Holding the key holds the touch, so ship and wave modes work too.
